::: {#sol-dup-odd}

No.
If $s$ has $n$ symbols, then $\operatorname{dup}(s) = s s$ has $2n$ symbols, an even number.
The string $010$ has 3 symbols, an odd number,
so it is not $\operatorname{dup}(s)$ for any $s$.
So $010$ is in the codomain $\set{0, 1}^*$ of $\operatorname{dup}$ but not in its image (@def-image).

:::
